image_description: A vintage, heavy cast-iron charcoal or electric iron resting on a dark wooden stand against a teal backdrop. The iron features a thick, blocky metal body with visible signs of age and rust, a curved wooden handle attached via metal brackets, and a series of circular ventilation holes along the side of the base. The soleplate is partially visible but largely obscured by the angle and the stand.

The body is clearly metal (cast iron/steel), fitting the 'metal body' description, though not 'molded plastic'.
